column2: >The Bertie Dog Collar – Durable, Stylish, and Secure for Your Dog’s ID Tags

>The Bertie Dog Collar is a must-have accessory for dog owners who want a reliable and stylish collar to hold their dog’s ID tags. It’s customisable with your choice of colour and metal hardware, so you can make it as unique as your dog. Crafted from abrasion-resistant, water and bacteria-resistant webbing, this collar is not only durable but also easy to clean.
